scene.label: Sound familiar?
scene.title: Those restless moments before sleep
scene.desc: Insomnia isn't just being unable to sleep — it's a mind that won't let you rest.
scene.note: It's not that you won't sleep. Your mind needs to be heard.

cards.title: Late-night work anxiety
cards.body: Tomorrow's presentation, rehearsed a hundred times in your head. The longer you lie there, the more awake you get.

cards.title: The harder you try, the worse it gets
cards.body: You check the clock — 2:17 AM. Why won't your brain just power down?

cards.title: Thoughts that won't stop
cards.body: It's not that you don't want to sleep — your mind just won't quit. Past and future, round and round.

product.label: What it is
product.title: What is ZhiMian
product.lead: Not a sleep gadget. Not a pill to knock you out.
product.highlight: A bedtime companion for your mind.
product.body: ZhiMian draws on the core ideas of cognitive behavioral therapy. Through a gentle pre-sleep conversation, it helps you say the noise in your head out loud and set it down — so your mind stops fighting itself.

cards.title: Bedtime chat
cards.body: Talk it out with an AI companion. Saying the worry out loud is what lets the mind finally relax.

cards.title: Sleep diary
cards.body: Three simple questions a day. Let the data show you what's really going on.

cards.title: Sleep nudge
cards.body: Awake after 20 minutes in bed? A gentle prompt to get up and give your brain a reset.

cards.title: Sleep efficiency
cards.body: Set your time in bed scientifically. Weekly summaries make progress visible.

science.title: A science-backed way to handle pre-sleep anxiety
science.body: CBT-I (Cognitive Behavioral Therapy for Insomnia) is a clinically researched intervention for insomnia. ZhiMian draws on its core ideas to offer warm pre-sleep companionship — it does not replace medical diagnosis or treatment.

stats.v:
A first-line therapy
per US sleep medicine

testimonials.label: Real feedback
testimonials.title: They come to ZhiMian at night

cards.name: Beta user B

cards.name: Beta user C

story.label: Our story
story.title: Where we started
story.quote: It's not that we can't sleep — we just have too much to say before bed, and no one listening.
story.body: ZhiMian started from something simple: people who can't sleep need a place to be heard. Not to be rushed to sleep, but to have their mind cleared. We're not a sleep-medicine startup. We're the support crew for everyone who lies awake.

cta.title: Open ZhiMian before bed
cta.sub: Five minutes before sleep, and let your mind truly rest
steps: Open WeChat, tap the search bar at the top
Open it before bed each night and say what's on your mind
